original_test_intent: Verify every in-scope fan's BMC-reported name, operational status, speed and part number against the approved cooling topology and vendor semantics.
original_method: Bind the target BMC and physical fan locations, query the documented read-only fan records or UI, capture all four requested fields per fan and compare them with the approved topology, status vocabulary and speed rules.
manual_activity: An operator may need to capture fields when the supported platform path is UI-only; otherwise collection and comparison can be automated after the fan schema and topology are supplied.
required_inputs: Documented fan endpoint or UI path
Speed units, sampling, tolerance and stopped-fan semantics
safety_requirements: Never change fan curves, thresholds, overrides, power or BMC settings
Associate every value to one fan location
Reject stale, unitless or ambiguous data
Stop on unexpected stopped-fan or thermal anomaly
No automatic retry or hardware PASS claim
agent_execution_scope: Verify the target and cooling topology
Collect raw per-fan records or UI capture
Decode Name, Status, Speed with units/timestamp and Part Number
Compare each location with the approved oracle
Report without changing cooling controls or deciding the verdict
engineer_actions: Supply the vendor schema, topology and expected values
Define speed/status tolerances and redundancy semantics

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Inapplicable as the primary method: its TEMP_MB_CPU0~1 assertions belong to duplicate row 768, and generic sensor output does not establish all four requested fan fields.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the documented read-only BMC fan resource or approved UI. Use ipmitool only after a vendor-validated label, unit and physical-location mapping.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Name, Status, Speed, Part Number and the 5/5-minute fields are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Store raw records and a location-keyed comparison including redundancy state, speed units, sample time and part number.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds deterministic location binding and explicit speed/status semantics.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; every in-scope fan and all four fields remain required.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Speed varies with thermal policy and workload, and zero RPM may be valid only in an approved redundancy or fan-stop mode.

project_override_considerations: A project may define installed fan population, redundancy/fan-stop behavior and supported read path, but must document absent locations and may not substitute CPU-temperature sensors for fan identity, status, speed or part number.
expected_evidence: Raw fan endpoint response or UI capture
Per-fan Name, Status, Speed/unit/timestamp and Part Number
Expected-value and tolerance comparison with thermal context
Relevant preserved events and no-mutation proof

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Row 1490 consistently defines fan inventory; duplicate row 768 is isolated by variant and remains a CPU thermal sensor case.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The schema, topology and field semantics are finite project/package inputs; missing them requires confirmation rather than permanent blockage.

review_improvement: Removes duplicate-code CPU-sensor contamination and requires per-location fan identity, state, speed and part-number evidence with explicit units and thermal context.
independent_technical_reasoning: The inspection is read-only, but the proposed command targets the wrong case and the vendor schema, topology and speed semantics are unresolved. REQUIRES is therefore correct until those finite inputs are supplied.
